description: This file defines the DebugActions enum containing various static methods related to debugging and developer utilities within the OpenClaw macOS app. It includes functions for opening windows, files, folders, restarting components, sending notifications, toggling settings, and managing sessions and ports.

methods.name: openAgentEventsWindow
methods.description: Opens a new window displaying agent events, creating an NSWindow with a SwiftUI view.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Opens the log file in the system's file viewer, or shows an alert if the log file does not exist.

methods.name: openConfigFolder
methods.description: Opens the configuration folder in the system's file viewer.

methods.name: openSessionStore
methods.description: Opens the session store file or its containing folder.

methods.name: sendTestNotification
methods.description: Sends a test notification using the NotificationManager.

methods.name: sendDebugVoice
methods.description: Sends a debug voice command and returns the result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: restartGateway
methods.description: Restarts the gateway process depending on the current connection mode.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel if in remote mode, establishing a new control tunnel.

methods.name: pinoLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the pino log file or fallbacks to the launchd log path.

methods.name: runHealthCheckNow
methods.description: Triggers an immediate health check refresh.

methods.name: sendTestHeartbeat
methods.description: Requests a heartbeat status and returns the event data or an error.

methods.name: verboseLoggingEnabledMain
methods.description: Checks if verbose logging is enabled in user defaults.

methods.name: toggleVerboseLoggingMain
methods.description: Toggles verbose logging setting and notifies the control channel.

methods.name: restartApp
methods.description: Restarts the application by relaunching the bundle.

methods.name: restartOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state and restarts the onboarding process.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the session store path from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: recentSessions
methods.description: Retrieves recent sessions up to a specified limit.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session's thinking and verbose levels via control channel.

methods.name: checkGatewayPorts
methods.description: Diagnoses open gateway ports.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Attempts to kill a process given its PID, with fallback to force kill.

methods.name: openSessionStoreInCode
methods.description: Opens the session store in VSCode.
